name: count_based_redundancy
observable_information: route IDs and nominal machine/resource count
action_semantics: Count candidate alternatives; no qualification or common-cause reasoning

name: route_diversity_only
observable_information: route structures and declared operation eligibility
action_semantics: Count distinct candidate routes; ignore evidence validity and shared roots

name: qualification_aware
action_semantics: Reject stale, revoked, mismatched, unknown and incomplete paths

name: fault_domain_aware
observable_information: complete typed prerequisites and declared fault-domain projection
action_semantics: Compute available paths and pairwise disjoint qualified-path subsets

name: adaptive_resilience
observable_information: same observable evidence plus authorized requalification/action costs
action_semantics: Select a surviving qualified route or perform bounded, justified requalification

name: exact_tiny_oracle
observable_information: same observable evidence as deployable arms
action_semantics: Exhaustively enumerate feasible route/qualification choices for tiny fixtures

name: full_reconfiguration
observable_information: same observable evidence and #5411 chronology inputs
action_semantics: Release all affected commitments and rebuild the route
